newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate ends slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate ends slightly firmer.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate closed slightly firmer on Monday due to banks' caution over Tuesday's auction of T$15 billion in treasury bills, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate finished at 4.808 percent against Saturday's 4.781 close, with 30-day commercial paper unchanged at 4.75-4.80.
The money rates are expected to rise further on Tuesday amid concern of tightening liquidity.
The bond market was quiet due to a lack of fresh market-moving factors. A consolidation is likely to continue in the near term, dealers said. -- Julie Hu (5080815)
